input.summary:
Guest bedroom (Bedroom 8) is designed in parts/room-6.mjs: a red bed on the south wall opposite the north door, a chest dresser and barrel wardrobe, a side table with chair by the west window, a red rug, a bedside lantern and a hanging lantern on a chain.
On an unlocked scratch copy the room reads well: light min 10 with no dark or dim cell, fit OK, and the interior render looks right.
In the real make.sh build none of it lands: the shell fills the main-block air, runParts locks it, and all 22 writes are refused. build.nbt is whole but the room is empty.

waste.what: Worked out the 6x7 layout cell by cell, including the lanes from both doors, the table, chair and rug positions, and the lantern and chain heights
waste.cost: one planning pass plus one layout draft, about 2 minutes
waste.tool: mcd plan could print the lane cells it wants kept clear and suggest furniture spots that keep 1-wide paths to every door

waste.what: Diagnosed the air lock by reading shell.mjs and the REFUSED report to find that the shell's air fill is the cause
waste.cost: three greps and one report read
waste.tool: runParts should report which earlier part locked a cell and why (for example 'shell fill air x27..68 z43..60'), so a worker does not need to read the shell source

waste.what: Checked the furniture on an unlocked scratch copy by calling build() directly on the loaded grid, to get the light and fit numbers
waste.cost: one scratch script and two room checks
waste.tool: a mcd room --preview <module> option that applies a part module to a copy without runParts' lock would make this a single command

companions.task: Fix shell.mjs line 27 so the main-block interior is left unwritten instead of filled with air; it is the only thing blocking every room part in the main block.
Check the room's light on the real merged build once the lock is fixed, since the hanging lantern and bedside lantern are placed by hand.

left: BLOCKER (outside my module): shell.mjs line 27 fills x27..68 z43..60 with air; runParts locks every cell an earlier part wrote, air included, so all 22 writes of room-6 are refused in make.sh. The shell must leave interiors unwritten (a fresh grid is already air). Noted in plan.md's Notes.

Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE (0 of 42 cells from the entrance) in both the real build and the scratch copy: no route into the house yet, which depends on the hall, corridors and shell doors, not on this room.
Light and fit are verified only on the unlocked scratch copy (min light 10, no dark or dim cell, fit OK); the real build has none of the furniture, so the room is still dark there.
plan.md checklist and elements.md were not ticked: the room is not built in the merged build.
